checkout_reference_hashes.scope: checkout reference files only; not identities of imported/executed modules

executed_metadata.scope: selected actual imported module origins and available bytecode; not a complete dependency closure

conditional_compiler_grouped_publication.condition: compiler logical row concatenation only; GKM numeric graph, resource admission, source bytes and publication construction remain separate

conditional_unfused_publication.condition: one matrix per lowered semantic linear/output-head operation; final groups unresolved

geometry.distinct_encoding_policy: float32 table and i16 head are separate physical owners
excluded_from_geometry: decoded EC owners and MSM scratch
KV, local execution and verifier queues
source publication generation and delivery scratch

numeric_profile: nearest-even(exact_binary_value*2048), signed-i16 weights, ring64 linear arithmetic

publication_work_before_report_serializa.scope: process-cumulative CPU/RSS counters at this observation; subsequent work excluded

remaining_gates: GKM numeric schedule and publication owner layout
admitted actual encoded-input bounds at every stage
bias/local float32 operation placement and order
complete original numerical graph, verification and lifecycle

resource_guard_before_report_serializati.policy: available memory reserve >= max(4GiB, total/8); any new swap aborts
resource_guard_before_report_serializati.scope: single scanner process through last completed observation; not a lifetime or hard-limit guarantee

fused_groups.scope: declared source grouping; not source integrity, numeric or runtime admission
